text: The Big Blue Wave will start right here in the stormy Atlantic waters near Mar-a-Lago where I came to speak to a sold-out crowd of 450 fervent activists at the Palm Beach County Democratic Party dinner, campaigned with the sparkling new House candidate Pia Dandiya (greatest new name in American politics!) in the 22nd, a former teacher and principal running a powerful grassroots campaign, and talked with Rep. Maxwell Frost to large groups of very inspiring young people from Democracy Summer classes past and future. These Sunshine State Dems are surging—more upsets in the making!
